title: Comparable Decellularization of Fetal and Adult Cardiac Tissue Explants as 3D-like Platforms for In Vitro Studies
protocol: Mix 8 g of NaCl, 1.01 g of Na2HPO4, 200 mg of KCl, and 200 mg of KH2PO4 with 900 mL of deionized water for 1x PBS.
Adjust the pH of the 1x PBS solution to 7.5 and the final volume up to 1 L.
Filter, autoclave, and store the 1x PBS solution at room temperature.
Dissolve 1.21 g of TrisBASE and 1 g of EDTA in 900 mL of deionized water for Hypotonic Buffer.
Adjust the pH of the Hypotonic Buffer to 7.8 with NaOH/HCl and the final volume up to 1 L.
Filter, sterilize by autoclave, and store the Hypotonic Buffer at room temperature.
Add 0.6 g of TrisBASE and 1 g of sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) in 400 mL of deionized water for 0.2% SDS solution.
Stir the mixture at 60 °C until complete solute dissolution for 0.2% SDS solution.
Let the solution to cool down to room temperature after solute dissolution.
Adjust the pH of the 0.2% SDS solution to 7.8 and the final volume up to 500 mL.
Sterilize the 0.2% SDS solution by filtration only after complete SDS dissolution.
Mix 1.21 g of TrisBASE in 900 mL of DI water.
Adjust the pH of the Tris solution to 7.8 and the final volume to 1 L.
Filter and sterilize the hypotonic wash buffer by autoclaving.
Store the hypotonic wash buffer at room temperature (RT).
Dissolve 2.42 g of TrisBASE and 2 mL of 1 M MgCl2 in 900 mL of DI water.
Adjust the pH to 7.8 and the final volume to 1 L for the DNase treatment solution.
Filter and sterilize the DNase treatment buffer by autoclaving.
Store the DNase treatment buffer at RT.
Add DNase I (50 U/mL) to the DNase treatment solution prior to use.
Prepare a DNase buffer containing 50% glycerol, 20 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, and 1 mM MgCl2 in DI water to reach a final volume of 10 mL.
Mix DNase I powder gently with the DNase buffer until complete dissolution.
Sterilize the solution through a 0.22 μm filter.
Prepare 1 mL aliquots of the DNase stock solution and store at -20°C.
Euthanize adult pregnant females at 18 days of gestation via CO2 asphyxiation.
Perform a cesarean section on the females using surgical scissors and collect the uterine horns bearing fetal mice to a Petri dish with ice-cold PBS.
Open the uterine horns and amniotic sacs to isolate the fetuses.
Transfer the fetuses to a new Petri dish with ice-cold PBS to anesthetize them.
Decapitate the fetuses with scissors.
Euthanize 7-8 weeks old male C57BL/6 mice using CO2 asphyxiation.
Perform an incision on each mouse chest and collect the heart.
Briefly rinse fetal and adult hearts with ice cold 1x PBS.
Remove the atria of adult heart with a scalpel.
Perform an incision on the right ventricle and remove it using straight small scissors.
Expose the left ventricle inner wall by removing the septum.
Divide the left ventricle free-wall in longitudinal strips with 2 mm thickness with a scalpel using a 2 mm x 2 mm grid.
Remove the papillary muscle using a scalpel and serrated tweezers with curved tips.
Excise small tissue explants with a scalpel.
Briefly rinse tissue explants with 1x PBS.
Add ~250 µL of OCT compound to autoclaved 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Transfer whole fetal hearts and adult cardiac explants to the tubes with 250 µL of OCT.
Freeze tissue samples with dry ice-cooled isopentane and store at -80 °C (to a maximum of 6 months).
Remove tissue samples from the -80°C freezer.
Transfer cardiac tissue block from OCT to a Petri dish with 1x PBS as OCT partially melts.
Wash samples in 1x PBS and at 60 rpm for 10-15 min using a shaker.
Repeat washing steps at least twice.
Add 1 mL of working Hypotonic Buffer per well to a sterile 24-well tissue culture plate.
Transfer one sample per well with forceps.
Move the 24-well tissue culture plate to an incubator shaker at 25 °C.
Incubate samples for 18 h with Hypotonic Buffer.
Prepare a 0.2% SDS solution as described in section 1.3 on DAY 2.
Aspirate the Hypotonic Buffer from the wells.
Wash the samples with 1x PBS for 1 hour.
Repeat the PBS wash three times.
Add 1 mL of freshly made SDS solution per well and incubate overnight at room temperature.
Ensure that samples exhibit a white to translucent appearance post-SDS treatment.
Remove the SDS solution slowly.
Wash the samples with Hypotonic Wash Buffer (1 mL per well) for 20 min on DAY 3.
Repeat the wash three times.
Add 1 mL of DNase Treatment solution per well and incubate at 37 °C for 3 h.
Aspirate the DNase Treatment solution from the wells.
Wash the samples with 1x PBS (1 mL per well) for 20 min.
Repeat the PBS wash three times.
Perform a final wash with 1x PBS overnight at room temperature and shaking at 60 rpm.
Ensure that decellularized samples have lost their gelatin-like consistency after DNase treatment.
Remove and add 1x PBS gently to avoid entrapping samples in pipette tips.
Fix the samples in a 24-well tissue culture plate by adding 1 mL of freshly made 10% formalin neutral buffer with 0.03% aqueous eosin for 2.5-3 hours at room temperature.
Wash the fixed samples with 1 mL of 1x PBS.
Encapsulate the fixed bioscaffolds in histology processing gel using a disposable vinyl specimen mold according to manufacturer's instructions.
Remove the histology gel with the sample embedded from the mold and transfer to Biopsy Processing/Embedding Cassettes with Lid.
Incubate samples in 70% alcohol for 30 min.
Incubate samples in 80% alcohol for 30 min.
Incubate samples in 90% alcohol for 30 min.
Incubate samples in 100% alcohol for 30 min.
Incubate samples in second 100% alcohol for 30 min.
Incubate samples in isoparaffinic aliphatic hydrocarbon solution for 30 min.
Incubate samples in paraffin at 56 °C for 30 min.
Incubate samples in second paraffin at 56 °C for 30 min.
Mount samples in a paraffin block.
Cut 3 μm-thick paraffin sections on a microtome and collect the sections on glass microscope slides.
Dry paraffin sections overnight at 37 °C.
Weigh a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube on a high precision digital scale.
Transfer cardiac tissue to the tube.
Remove extra 1x PBS from the tube containing the cardiac tissue.
Weigh the tube with the samples.
Calculate the wet weight of the samples: Sample wet weight = weight tube with samples – weight empty tube.
Decellularize the samples as described in Step 3.
Collect decellularized tissues into a microcentrifuge tube.
Pool decellularized tissues from each sample condition (fetal heart: 5 whole hearts; adult LV explants: 15 explants).
Perform the same procedure with non-manipulated tissue.
Cut non-manipulated and decellularized tissues into small explants with a scalpel in a clean Petri dish.
Use an individual scalpel and Petri dish for each sample.
Mechanically disrupt the samples to facilitate enzymatic digestion and subsequent DNA extraction.
Extract DNA from the disrupted samples using a spin-column based method according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Collect the mechanically dissociated samples from the Petri dish with the master digestion buffer according to the manufacturer's instructions using a wide orifice pipette tip.
Keep lysed samples on ice until all samples are lysed.
Incubate the lysed samples for 4-6 hours at room temperature.
Elute DNA from decellularized tissue samples in 25-50 μL of elution buffer.
Elute DNA from non-decellularized tissue samples in 100 μL of elution buffer.
Load the spin-column with collected eluted DNA and incubate for 1 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge the samples according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Store extracted DNA at -20°C until further use.
Quantify extracted DNA using a fluorescent dsDNA detection kit following the manufacturer's instructions.
Normalize the DNA content as nanograms of DNA per milligram of initial sample wet weight.
Prepare 1x DPBS with 2.5 μg/mL of amphotericin B and 1% P/S (penicillin, 100 I.U.; streptomycin 100 µg/mL).
Remove the 1x PBS solution from the last decellularization washing step.
Add 500 μl per well of freshly prepared 1x DPBS/2.5 μg/ml amphotericin B/1% P/S solution.
Store samples at 4°C for 1-7 days.
Aspirate 1x DPBS/2.5 μg/ml amphotericin B/1% P/S solution from the decellularized samples.
Add 500 μl per well of cell basal media/1% P/S and let samples equilibrate for 1 h at 37°C or at 4°C for more than 1 h.
Split the cells of interest and prepare small aliquots of cells at the desired density.
Transfer decellularized scaffolds to a DPBS drop using thin and straight tweezers.
Remove extra DPBS by aspiration.
Let the sample become dry at the edges to adhere to the well surface.
Add cells to the scaffold by pipetting the single-cell solution slowly against the edges of the well.
